tools.name: analyze_wallet
tools.description: Analyses a wallet the way walletprofit.app does: total value, holdings, liquidity (LP) positions with fee rates and range status, lending positions net of debt, and all-time profit. EVM addresses (0x… or an ENS name) are read on every supported chain at once; Solana and Bitcoin addresses too. A wall

tools.name: get_venue_rates
tools.description: Today's rates on one venue, as its walletprofit.app page ranks them: lending (supply APY, by asset class), borrowing costs, isolated borrow markets, and liquidity pools (fee APR, TVL, 24h volume). Rates are the lowest of the venue's recent readings, so one good day does not lead. Updated daily.

tools.name: get_market_prices
tools.description: BTC, ETH and SOL, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, the US 10-year yield, gold, Brent crude, EUR/USD and USD/CNY, with their change over the last hour and day. Read once a minute.
